rate_limits: JSON/YAML API: 20 requests/minute; one-hour block when exceeded. Other LOC services have separate limits.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor correct; original "not published" is wrong. Official docs (https://www.loc.gov/apis/json-and-yaml/working-within-limits/) publish JSON/YAML API limits as 20 requests/minute with a 1-hour block when exceeded; Text/Image microservices are 150/min with the same block window.
